nonBlockingObservations.title: Make the finalization walk’s source explicit
nonBlockingObservations.detail: Step 4 prices a descent into tree/, one descent per committed directory, and each file open/mode/barrier, but it has no separate readdir row. This is implementable by driving post-order from the borrowed authenticated TreeCommitment while retaining the current parent stack. A fresh filesystem enumeration would instead require additional listing charges; descend_cost covers stream setup, not readdir calls. V1 and V2 already price their independent full filesystem enumeration.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: State that step 4 is manifest-driven and performs no additional unpriced listing or per-entry parent-chain restart. If native enumeration is chosen instead, add its bounded rd term. In CI-T22, distinguish V1/V2 listing calls from finalization and verify the chosen traversal has exactly the priced descents.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Restore the standalone definition of record length R
nonBlockingObservations.detail: The r5 edit removes r4’s paragraph defining R, although the arithmetic paragraph still points to its definition below and both recipes use R. The closed generation.json schema and authenticated association fields remain present, so the intended quantity is clear, but the explicit pre-acquisition canonical-length derivation should remain in the current operative text rather than only in superseded history.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Restore R as the exact canonical byte length of item 5’s closed record derived from authenticated release/candidate fields, with escaped UTF-8 payload lengths and checked arithmetic computed before acquisition/allocation. Preserve the single owned expected record and bounded byte comparison.

nonBlockingObservations.title: Select the finalization handle access mode before the charged open
nonBlockingObservations.detail: P-3 allows opening read-write where a read-only handle cannot support the selected metadata/barrier operation. This is compatible with the one-open fopen price when access mode is selected by the qualified platform behavior before opening the staging file. Trying read-only, failing after chmod, and then reopening read-write would add unfunded calls, violate the failure latch/no-retry discipline, and may fail because the file is already 0400/0500.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: Describe this as advance platform-specific access-mode selection for regular files, before their final chmod, with the chosen handle retained through the barrier. Keep directory handles on the supported directory-open path. A native chmod/barrier failure ends the act; it does not trigger a retry or a durability fallback. Have CI-2’s native controls record the selected mode and one-open sequence.
